type: u32 count, flagged u32 pointer, u32[count] section-relative offsets (0xFFFFFFFF = null, 35 in the tutorial)

evidence.summary: Clone + null-slot list entry: level loads (15 341 kB served), scene identical to control in 2/2 runs

CONTRADICTION: the offsets array is BEFORE the flagged word (which is its end), so the 35 "null slots" were 0xFFFFFFFF words inside objects and the M3 list write landed inside an object; superseded by igz.section1.header-table

meaning: Superseded by igz.section1.header-table: the array of section-relative offsets lies between the 8 header words and the flagged end word; there are no null slots. The first M3 clone was therefore never listed anywhere, which, with igz.loader.pointer-traversal, explains why it stayed inert.
structure: Section-1 header list (count 0xB32) and its null slots
